description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the variable N and the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage, comparing the performance of different models or configurations. The x-axis is labeled 'N', has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'AUC (%)', also has a linear scale, ranges from 75 to 100, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. There are five lines in the plot, each representing a different model or configuration, distinguished by their colors and marker shapes. The blue line with circle markers starts at around 95% AUC at N=1, increases to approximately 99% at N=5 and N=10, and then decreases to about 94% at N=20. The orange line with square markers begins at around 87% AUC at N=1, rises to about 99% at N=10, and then drops to approximately 91% at N=20. The green line with star markers starts at around 85% AUC at N=1, increases steadily to about 94% at N=20. The yellow line with diamond markers begins at around 86% AUC at N=1, increases to about 96% at N=15, and then slightly decreases to approximately 95% at N=20. The purple line with triangle markers starts at around 80% AUC at N=1, remains relatively stable until N=5, then sharply increases to about 96% at N=10, before decreasing to approximately 80% at N=20.
